calculation.expression: -(rolling_sum_3(asset_return - cross_sectional_median_return)) / rolling_std_20(asset_return) * clip((cross_sectional_mean_abs_return_deviation / rolling_median_60(dispersion)) - 1, 0, 2), then cross-sectional median-center
calculation.description: Buy relative losers and avoid relative winners over three sessions after removing the daily cross-asset median move. Scale each asset residual by its 20-day volatility and smoothly activate the reversal only when cross-asset absolute return dispersion is above its trailing 60-day median. All inputs are lagged through the completed decision day; the persisted artifact contains the resulting daily signal.

validation.regime_notes: Positive 1-day IC in sampled 2020, 2023, 2025, and 2026-07 onward subperiods. The 1-day horizon passes the benchmark absolute IC >= 0.0070 and absolute ICIR >= 0.0840 gates. Predictive decay is materially weaker at 5 days and absent at 10 days; small cross-section requires conservative interpretation.
